Hi Ben,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve earlier today and I'm evaluating how it would fit into GraphKit's developer workflow. We have a few immediate integration questions before a demo:

- Does the Redwood GitHub App support installation on org-level and private repos?
- Can we use it with GitHub Actions on self-hosted runners?
- Any on-prem / VPC deployment considerations for code access?

Would love to book a quick 30 min demo next week to see the integration flow and install steps. I'm in CET (UTC+1) and can do 10:00–12:00 or 16:00–18:00 CET most days.

Hi Samira — thanks for signing up and for the great questions.

Short answers:
- Yes: org and repo-level installations are supported.
- Yes: we support GitHub Actions including self-hosted runners; there are a few caveats around runner network egress (happy to walk through them).
- For on-prem/VPC we offer Private deployment; we'll cover what requires network access vs. a connector.

Would any of these slots work for a 30-min demo (I'll include Marissa for the technical deep-dive):
- Tue 2026-12-08 10:30 CET / 04:30 ET
- Wed 2026-12-09 16:00 CET / 10:00 ET
- Thu 2026-12-10 11:00 CET / 05:00 ET

Or use my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/30min

Attaching our GitHub App one-pager so you can skim before the call.

Best,
Ben Carter
